question: What was the theme of the 78th World Health Assembly, 2025, held in Geneva in May 2025?

options.text: Health for All: Building Resilient Systems
Universal Health Coverage: A Global Need

solution: The correct answer is __**One World for Health**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **78th World Health Assembly**, held in **May 2025 in Geneva**, focused on the theme "**One World for Health**," emphasizing the need for global collaboration in tackling health challenges. • The theme highlighted the importance of a **unified global response** to health crises such as pandemics, climate change, and inequities in healthcare systems. • It stressed the significance of **cross-border partnerships** to strengthen healthcare infrastructure, promote equity, and achieve sustainable health outcomes worldwide. • This initiative aimed at aligning the efforts of various countries, organizations, and stakeholders towards the goal of **Universal Health Coverage (UHC)** and ensuring equitable access to healthcare for all populations. • The Assembly brought together health ministers, policymakers, and international organizations to discuss strategies for building **resilient health systems** capable of addressing future global health challenges.
